scripts.i: cd ../ && npm i && npm run pack && cd ./example && npm i
scripts.reStart: npm run install:pkg && npm run codegen && hdc rport tcp:8081 tcp:8081 && react-native start
scripts.start: hdc rport tcp:8081 tcp:8081 && react-native start
scripts.install:pkg: npm uninstall @react-native-ohos/react-native-svga && npm run pack:pkg && npm i @react-native-ohos/react-native-svga@file:../react-native-ohos-react-native-svga-1.0.0-beta.1.tgz
scripts.fast-install-project: cd ../ && npm i --force && npm pack && node -e "const fs=require('fs');try{fs.rmSync('node_modules',{recursive:true,force:true,maxRetries:10,retryDelay:300})}catch(e){console.warn('[warn] node_modules 删除失败(可能被占用)，跳过继续: '+e.message)}" && cd ./example && npm i --force
scripts.fast:pkg: npm run fast-install-project && npm run dev
